references.text: Describes the flaying of the burnt offering, which is the action that results in the skin that the priest keeps according to Lev 7:8
Part of the same legal collection concerning the burnt offering and the priests' rights related to the sacrifices
Continuation of the text dealing with the priests' share of various offerings, including the grain offering
Refers to the skin of the sin offering bull that was to be burned outside the camp, showing the difference between the sin offering and the burnt offering regarding the skin
Concerns the priests' portion of the offerings as part of their compensation for service
The first time God makes garments of skin for humans, showing early use of animal hides
Paul refers to the principle that those who serve at the altar receive their share from the offering, the same principle found in Lev 7:8
